FontResolution.title: FontResolution
FontResolution.description: D-018 cascade result for one node's font. `resolved=None` means nothing matched (review item).

Node.title: Node
Node.description:
A layout node. Payload fields are optional and gated by `type` (text -> runs, image ->
assetId, group -> children, …). A single model keeps one JSON schema / one TS type; the
per-type payloads are enforced by `validate_payload` below rather than a discriminated union.

ReviewItem.title: ReviewItem
ReviewItem.description:
One queue entry from ingestion (architecture §6.6): validators and unmatched regions
propose; the user confirms. `confidence` gates "Accept all detected" (≥ 0.8, FR-TPL-02).
`id` is deterministic (`kind-###`) so the queue is stable across re-ingests.
